title: Dated basket price index (COO ruling 38 Part B, continuation Fix 2)
price_note: Total return = the dividend-adjusted close already used in the breadth history. Adjusted closes are today's restated values (split and dividend adjustment as of the Tiingo archive capture 2026-10-11..16), not the prices printed at the time. Data end 2026-10-09.
redistribution_note: Group-level index levels and counts only; no member prices, tickers or per-security dates. Member-level history stays off git.

index.rebalance_rule: engine.baskets._ew_level: equal-weight daily total-return level, cumprod of (1 + EW daily return) from 1.0 at the first active session; a member counts only inside its membership window
index.floor_rule: first date per key = earliest session with at least 5 priced members; rows below 5 keep n_priced_members with a blank index
index.floor_gap: below-floor sessions are blank; the chain stays flat across the gap and resumes from the last valid level

file.name: group_index_basket_daily_dated.parquet
file.membership: data/baskets/membership.json on main: every member row (including removed members) as its recorded [added, removed) inclusion window, the same mask engine/baskets.py and engine/us_basket_turn.py read; a member counts only on sessions inside its own window

dated_membership_start_note: Dated basket membership starts 2023-05-09 (the membership file's seed_date); before that date the basket has only the current-members sensitivity series (group_index_daily_current_sensitivity.parquet). The file span begins at the first session on/after the seed.
provenance_caveat: Reconstruction, not a point-in-time record. `added` is the index-inclusion mask; for the 35 baskets curated after the seed it is back-projected, so pre-curation history shows what today's recorded windows did, not what anyone held at the time. `curated_added` is the provenance stamp and is never earlier than the basket's created date; treat history before a member's curated_added as context, never as a track record. 34 member rows in 3 baskets carry a recorded added date (2023-01-03) earlier than the seed; they are effective from the first session on/after the seed in this file. This file supersedes the earlier no-dated-basket disposition recorded in group_index.meta.json, per the continuation brief: the dated windows are built as recorded, labelled reconstructed_dated_membership, with this caveat.

price_input.note: the same closes #11107 used and the sensitivity file uses

dropped_partial_rows_rule: centred 21-row median of priced names; a row under half is dropped (data cleaning, not a signal rule)
duplicate_series_rule: month-by-month hash of daily returns, then pairwise check: >=60 identical returns and >=95% identical between first and last identical session; the second ticker is counted once over the span. Detection and labelling only; no store repaired. Pair tickers are not committed (group-level counts only).
no_outcomes: Data only. Descriptive group levels and counts. No outcome relation, no backtest, no hit rate, no signal, ranking or score column.
engine: engine.baskets._ew_level; scripts/build_group_breadth_history.py dated loaders; prior-round method /tmp/r38b/build_house.py dated_index
